correctness.rationale: Reconstructed the rank-one drifted Gaussian resolvent F0(r)=[k/(k+sqrt(v²+4Dr))] exp[-(v+sqrt(v²+4Dr))x0/(2D)], renewal mean (1-F0)/(rF0), and m_{a,K}(rho)=[exp(a+sqrt(a²+rho))(1+sqrt(a²+rho)/K)-1]/rho. For J=rho H'-H, J'=rho H'', and H'' has one sign-transition quadratic u²+(K+1)u-(K+1), proving unique minimum by small/large-rate limits. The perfect-absorber b=1 threshold and expansions give rho*~sqrt(8b^4/((b-1)K)) for b>1, rho*~(24/K)^(1/3) at b=1, and the scaled root t^3+3 lambda t²=24 for b=1+lambda K^(-1/3). Verified the coercivity argument needed to rule out escaping minimizers; independent numerical derivative/minimizer checks corroborate but do not prove every parameter.
residual_risks: Computational examples alone do not establish quantification beyond checked finite parameters; the analytical or finite-exhaustive proof is separately evaluated.

Full text of Mazzolo (2026), including its optimal-rate appendix, treats the same delta trap and supplies an arbitrary-drift implicit optimum equation, so those pieces are explicitly NOT claimed original. The final claim is the global uniqueness for all finite K and all drift, plus sharp reactivity-threshold square/cubic scaling and critical crossover; these were not found as statements in the inspected full article or other primary reset papers. Qualified best-of-knowledge PASS, with potential implicit reduction in earlier optimization literature.
